name: Amansinaya
description: Star of 5,700 K, 132 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: WASP-34 b crosses Amansinaya as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.

quotes.title: WASP-34
quotes.card: WASP-34, also named Amansinaya, is a sunlike star of spectral type G5V that has 1.01 times the mass and 0.93 times the diameter of the Sun.
quotes.introduction: It rotates on its axis every 34±15 days, indicating it is around 6.7 billion years old.
